title: pleurogyne rotata var. bella
intro: Pleurogyne rotata var. bella, commonly known as the 'bella' variety of Pleurogyne rotata, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family. It is a plant used in traditional herbal medicine, particularly in Southeast Asia, valued for its potential health benefits and therapeutic properties. The bioactive constituents of Pleurogyne rotata var. bella include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Pleurogyne rotata var. bella include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardiovascular protective effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
